content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was that the method `orgDao.findByCommonName(...)` was not mocked in the test `NewAccountFormControllerTest`, leading to a NullPointerException (NPE) when the method was called during the test execution. This occurred because the test relied on the behavior of the `orgDao` without providing a mock implementation, resulting in the test failing when it attempted to access a method on a null object.
